# Replacement training

Used in [Organisation](/rules/70-organisation).

## Table

| Class | Stages |
|---|---|
| gun | 1 |
| infantry | 3 |
| tank | 6 |
| armoured car | 6 |
| recce | 6 |

## Notes

- Training may begin in the stage of arrival
- Distinct from Commonwealth morale training (SPI 17.3)
- Infantry replacement points earmarked for the Commonwealth 1/2 to 2/2 upgrade need no training (SPI 20.77)
